teaser.en: The wooden sandals once worn along the Swahili coast were carved from this tree, and its name remembers them.
teaser.sw: Viatu vya mbao vilivyovaliwa zamani katika pwani ya Waswahili vilichongwa kutoka mti huu, na jina lake linavikumbuka.

summary.en: *Mpalawanda*, the bell bean tree, is a small tree of dry coastal forest and secondary bush with yellow and maroon trumpet flowers. Its wood was cut into traditional wooden sandals, *mitawanda*, and is still used for poles, bows and tool handles.
summary.sw: *Mpalawanda*, au *mtawanda*, ni mti mdogo wa misitu mikavu ya pwani na vichaka vya pili wenye maua ya umbo la tarumbeta ya rangi ya njano na hudhurungi-nyekundu. Mbao zake zilikatwa kutengeneza viatu vya jadi vya mbao, *mitawanda*, na bado hutumika kwa nguzo, pinde na mipini ya zana.

about.en: *Mpalawanda* is a small tree or shrub with pinnate leaves. Its trumpet-shaped flowers are yellow, marked with maroon. The pods that follow are long, thin and twisted, typical of its family.
about.sw: *Mpalawanda* ni mti mdogo au kichaka chenye majani yaliyogawanyika kama manyoya. Maua yake yenye umbo la tarumbeta ni ya njano, yenye alama za hudhurungi-nyekundu. Maganda yanayofuata ni marefu, membamba na yaliyosokotwa, kama ilivyo kawaida kwa familia yake.

where.en: It grows in dry forest and secondary bush along the coast.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu mikavu na vichaka vya pili kando ya pwani.

uses.en:
The wood is cut into traditional Swahili wooden sandals, *mitawanda*.

It is also used for poles and firewood, and for bows, arrows and tool handles.
uses.sw:
Mbao hukatwa kutengeneza viatu vya jadi vya mbao vya Kiswahili, *mitawanda*.

Pia hutumika kwa nguzo na kuni, na kwa pinde, mishale na mipini ya zana.

culture.en: The tree's Digo name refers to the wooden sandals, *mitawanda*, made from it.
culture.sw: Jina la Kidigo la mti huu linarejelea viatu vya mbao, *mitawanda*, vinavyotengenezwa kutokana nao.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mpalawanda*. In Swahili it is *mtawanda*, and in Giriama *muchalanda*. In English it is called the bell bean tree. The ICRAF handbook lists it under the related *Markhamia lutea*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mpalawanda*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mtawanda*, na kwa Kigiriama *muchalanda*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *bell bean tree*. Kitabu cha ICRAF kinauorodhesha chini ya spishi inayohusiana nao, *Markhamia lutea*.

reason.sw: Jamaa yake mwenye maua ya tarumbeta na maganda yaliyosokotwa
Mti mwingine wa familia ya maua ya tarumbeta
Pia hutumika kwa mipini ya zana
